scenes.title: The journey of a demo
scenes.talkingPoints: Six chapters, six features — and this tour will walk through every page itself.

actions.caption: The journey of a demo
actions.note: Six chapters. The tour drives every page itself.
One flow will now travel through all six chapters
Chapter 1: it starts with a recording

scenes.title: Chapter 1 — Perform it once
scenes.talkingPoints: You don't write a demo. You perform it once, and Studio writes it down.

actions.note: Press Record in Studio and just use the app
Keystrokes, toggles, scrolls — all become actions

scenes.title: Chapter 2 — It refuses to rot
scenes.talkingPoints: The product changed. The doctor re-matches the target by fingerprint and CI tells the PR that broke it.

actions.note: flow doctor finds the renamed selector…

scenes.title: Chapter 3 — Give it a voice
scenes.talkingPoints: The talking points you already write become the narration track.

actions.note: assemble --voice narrates the video from these very notes

scenes.title: Chapter 4 — Say their name, {{company}}
scenes.talkingPoints: One flow, personalized per prospect: {{company}} resolves from the share link.

actions.note: Typed for {{company}} — from the link, not the manifest

scenes.title: Chapter 5 — Send it out
scenes.talkingPoints: Viewers get minimal chrome; you get the funnel. This very tour has been emitting events the whole way.

actions.note: These metrics counted THIS tour, live

scenes.title: Chapter 6 — Let them drive
scenes.talkingPoints: The tour ends by handing the wheel to the viewer.

scenes.title: The end — and the beginning
scenes.talkingPoints: Recorded, self-healing, narrated, personalized, shared, and branching. One runtime, no backend.

actions.note: That was six features in one cross-page flow. The end.

scenes.title: Personalized for {{company}}
scenes.talkingPoints: The same session store a ?srv_company= link would fill.
